storyHeading: The group chat can leave the chat
storyParagraphs: Your group has one expert planner, one person who replies with a thumbs-up, and one friend who asks for the date again. We work with the whole crew, from four friends to a squad of 20, and turn the loose ideas into a practical plan with rooms, travel time and a clear cost for each person.

Choose a Goa break, a Manali or Leh adventure, a Rishikesh escape, or a longer trip through Meghalaya. For overseas plans, ask about Phuket, Bali, Vietnam, Dubai or the Asian Horizons route. Comfort Journey has planned travel from Bhopal since 1992, with real people available on WhatsApp and phone at +91 92039 31912 during your trip.

quickAnswer.question: How do I plan a group trip for friends?
quickAnswer.answer: Start with your group size, dates, destination ideas and a comfortable budget. Comfort Journey can customise the itinerary, arrange hotels, private cabs with drivers and activities, then share a clear quote upfront. For international trips, the team can also help with visas and stays. Ask on WhatsApp so everyone can review the same plan.

faqs.q: Can you plan a trip for four friends as well as a larger squad?
faqs.a: Yes. We work with groups from four to 20 friends. Tell us the number of travellers, room preferences and dates, and we will shape the plan around your group.

faqs.q: Which destinations suit a friends trip?
faqs.a: For India, popular starting points include Goa, Manali, Leh, Rishikesh and Meghalaya. You can also ask about Phuket, Bali, Vietnam, Dubai and multi-city Asian plans.

faqs.q: Can we choose our hotels and room setup?
faqs.a: Yes. Hotel choices range from 3-star to 5-star, with palaces and villas available for suitable plans. We discuss room needs before confirming the booking.

faqs.q: How much do friends trip packages cost?
faqs.a: The price changes with destination, dates, group size, room sharing, transport and activities. Send your details on WhatsApp and we will share an exact quote with the inclusions explained upfront.

faqs.q: Can you customise the itinerary for our group?
faqs.a: Yes. Every itinerary can be customised around your interests, pace and leave dates. You can ask for more sightseeing, more free time or a different hotel style before the quote is final.

faqs.q: Will someone help us during the trip?
faqs.a: Real people are available on WhatsApp and phone at +91 92039 31912, 24/7 during trips. For international travel, visa assistance is also available during planning.

finalHeading: Give the group chat a departure date
